power.answer: IndiGo's Conditions of Carriage allow up to two spare lithium-ion batteries, power banks included, of up to 100 Wh each, subject to airport security clearance. Banks from 100 to 160 Wh need approval at the check-in counter and are limited to two. They stay in carry-on, are never recharged or used to charge devices on board, and the Mobikins MK-PB-04 is banned outright.

sections.h: 🔋 What IndiGo says about power banks
sections.p: From clause 8, "Carriage of lithium batteries", of the IndiGo baggage policy, read on 22 November 2026.

list: Wording gap: the policy sets the approval step for devices above 100 Wh at the check-in counter, while another IndiGo page mentions calling the call centre in advance for other items. Ask IndiGo before you fly with a bank over 100 Wh.

faq: How many power banks can I take on IndiGo?
Two spare lithium batteries, power banks included, up to 100 Wh each, subject to airport security clearance.
Can I carry a 150 Wh power bank on IndiGo?
Only with IndiGo's approval at check-in and airport security clearance, and not more than two.
Is the Mobikins MK-PB-04 power bank allowed on IndiGo?
No. IndiGo prohibits it in cabin and checked baggage.
